# Change Management Policy

Revision: v10. Effective: 2025-05-02. Owner: VP of Engineering.

## 1. Purpose

This document sets the minimum requirements for change management. It exists so that each team applies the same
rules the same way, and so that an auditor can check that they do.

## 2. Scope

This document applies to the systems and suppliers listed in the asset register. Where a contract or a law imposes a stricter
requirement, the stricter requirement applies.

## 3. Definitions

- In-scope systems: each system listed in the asset register with this policy as its control set.
- Owner: the role accountable for this document and for approving exceptions to it.
- Confirmed event: an event that the response team has classified, as opposed to a report.
- Working day: Monday to Friday excluding public holidays at the registered office.

## 4. Requirements

- **R1.** Passwords are at least 16 characters long and are checked against a list of known compromised passwords.
- **R2.** Affected parties are notified within 2 days of a confirmed event.
- **R3.** Changes to in-scope systems follow the change process and are reviewed by a second person.
- **R4.** Test and development environments never hold production data unless it has been anonymised.
- **R5.** This document is reviewed each 12 months and after any incident that invokes it.
- **R6.** Encryption in transit uses current, non-deprecated protocol versions only.
- **R7.** Exceptions to this policy are authorised in writing by the document owner and recorded in the exception register.
- **R8.** Interactive sessions expire after 12 hours and require re-authentication.

## 5. Exceptions

Exceptions are granted only where a requirement cannot be met for technical or legal reasons, are
time-limited, and are reviewed at each scheduled review of this document.

## 6. Review and ownership

The owner of this document is the VP of Engineering, who approves exceptions and signs off each revision.
Material changes are communicated to all affected teams before they take effect.
